_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 73: 27-29 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He raises the objection that someone prayed for a man and he died, and answers that you keep trying and keep believing and keep standing on the word, getting that word down in your heart, and that the bigger the word gets the more it works.
mentions.quote: I prayed for that guy and he died. You keep trying
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the second time he has conceded outright that a healing prayer failed and a person died. Worth having beside the declarations.

mentions.claim_text: He voices what was said over his life, that he would be good for nothing and never make money or do anything with his life, and answers that he does not believe any of it and it is a lie because of what the Bible says.
mentions.quote: I don't believe anything you're saying. It's a lie

mentions.claim_text: He says a little becomes much and it keeps going, that as long as the earth remains seed time and harvest will always exist, that this is what the Bible says and he believes it is in Genesis, and mentions that the grass withers and the flower fades.
mentions.quote: As long as the earth remains, seed time and harvest will always exist
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the scriptural warrant under the sowing and giving appeals.

mentions.claim_text: He says the rest of 2026 and 2027 and 2028 and 2029 bring shaking in the church, that God is waking up his church, that it is not sad or scary that people are dying and going home because that is the cycle of life, and names shaking in the elections.
mentions.quote: the rest of 2026 2027 2028 2029 shaking in the church
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The window has now stretched from 2026 alone to a four year span, and deaths among the elderly are folded in as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is why they are there and he wants them to hear what he told them is coming concerning President Trump, that they are going to come against him really hard, and that if they do not get out and vote in November they will see it.
mentions.quote: They're going to come against him really hard
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained legal or political attack on the president.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Coming against him hard describes any administration in an election year.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as they see JD Vance in the days ahead, in 2028 they will call it the new Watergate, and that he saw Nixon and saw JD Vance and saw Elon Musk doing something together.
mentions.quote: in 2028 they will call it the new Watergate
mentions.falsify_match: A scandal in 2028 involving the two named men that is compared to Watergate.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such scandal. Two living people are named, which makes this far more checkable than the earlier Watergate tellings.

mentions.claim_text: He says he wants them to see again what he said about him being Nixon, that he relates with Nixon, that this is something he is telling them, and asks whether they have the clip.
mentions.quote: what he said again about him being Nixon. I relate with Nixon
mentions.falsify_match: A clip in which the named man compares himself to Nixon, offered as confirmation.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He plays someone asking what he is doing and saying that at a personal level, says he is just asking and is not against him, that this is what the Lord showed him and it will come out in the days ahead, and mentions a young senator.
mentions.quote: I'm not against him, but this is what the Lord showed me
mentions.falsify_match: Something emerging about the man in question.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing emerges. He states he is not against him while saying it will come out.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in his mind he is already justifying it, asks whether it sounds like he is trying to make a call or already covering himself, says he thought that was interesting, and that he sees it coming because of the things he sees.
mentions.quote: in his mind, he's already justifying it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a reading of an unnamed man's private reasoning.

mentions.claim_text: He says the US economy is a pig with lipstick and not what everybody says it was, that he saw interest rates exploding, and that Jerome Powell needs a job and is going to get let go as he told everybody he would.
mentions.quote: the US economy is a pig with lipstick
mentions.falsify_match: Interest rates rising sharply and the economy proving weaker than reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: Rates fall. Note he says Powell is going to be let go, six weeks after the term ended on schedule.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is sad to him, that the new golden age is coming and a new economic shift is coming, and that in his opinion an economic something is coming with a new digital era and a new digital age and a new economic AI.
mentions.quote: The new golden age is coming. A new economic shift is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A digital and AI driven economic transition.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Marked twice as his opinion, and the golden age and the beast system are the same transition described in opposite terms.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is the scale of the balances with the horsemen, that he said they will use it and will put poison in their rats and inject this and spread it all over Europe, tells them to see the rats with the poison, and that this is what the Lord warned them about.
mentions.quote: they will put poison in their rats and spread it all over Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate rodent-borne release in Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The mechanism has now been stated as rats, AI, chemical injection and poison across different tellings.

mentions.claim_text: He says that on the last broadcast when they were together the Lord said they are about to see a cleaning of his church like never before from July to December, that they will see corruption exposed, and that they will see things with some elders.
mentions.quote: a cleaning of my church like never before from July to December
mentions.falsify_match: A run of church corruption scandals in the second half of 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such run. This is the tightest window the cleansing claim has carried in eight months, and it can come due on 31 December.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them to watch CERN and asks whether they see it, repeats watch CERN and that there is something with it, that they are going to do some upgrades, asks what they want to look for and answers dark matter, and says there is something more.
mentions.quote: Watch CERN. They're going to do some upgrades. Dark matter
mentions.falsify_match: Upgrades at the facility and dark matter research, both of which are published and ongoing.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: the upgrade programme and the dark matter searches are matters of public record and were already under way.

mentions.claim_text: He says it concerns live streams like this one and that they will not allow it to happen in Europe, that he saw major things, and that black tentacles came out of this thing and started wrapping around their live streams and their internet in the days ahead, with socialistic control.
mentions.quote: black tentacles came out and started wrapping around your live streams
mentions.falsify_match: European restrictions on live streaming or online broadcast.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The image is his own and the mechanism is not described.

mentions.claim_text: He says it concerns the church, the governments and the world as a whole and what is coming, that it was a lot of instruction for his ministry, but that he can give them the pieces of it concerning what he saw coming in the next season.
mentions.quote: a lot of instruction for my ministry, but I can give you pieces
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the withholding rule again: most of what was given is kept back and only pieces are published.

mentions.claim_text: He is told he can skip ahead if he feels a strong flow, agrees, and says this is what the Lord showed him and that it started off with him saying July, the month he had shown him.
mentions.quote: He said July. I showed you the
mentions.falsify_match: Something in July matching what follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. The July material begins here.

mentions.claim_text: He says the seventh month goes into the second half of the year, and reports the Lord saying he told them at the beginning of the year about 1 Corinthians 5:5, that he was cleaning the bride and changing things in the church and bringing the bride to him.
mentions.quote: the seventh month going into the second half of the year
mentions.falsify_match: The church cleansing becoming visible from July.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Halfway through the year he named, the claim is being restated with a new start date rather than pointed at anything that has happened.

mentions.claim_text: He says it does not die automatically but happens over time, and that in this vision he saw ministries that think they are still alive and that those ministries will be proven otherwise.
mentions.quote: I saw ministries that think they're still alive
mentions.falsify_match: Named ministries closing or being exposed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Over time and nobody named means nothing can come due.
